expected_visuals.1: Wide view of the empty call center floor at 3 AM; a desk phone at the far end blinks red
expected_visuals.2: Extreme close-up of a desk phone display glowing, a hand hovering over the handset
expected_visuals.3: The narrator at his desk wearing a headset, tired, coworkers in the background
expected_visuals.4: Static wide: agents frozen at their desks, nobody looks at the ringing phone at the far desk
expected_visuals.5: Over-the-shoulder: the phone on the next desk lights up and rings
expected_visuals.6: POV dolly along a row of desks, phones lighting up red one by one toward the camera
expected_visuals.7: Night lobby of an office tower, an old guard at the desk lit by CCTV monitors
expected_visuals.8: Close-up of the guard's face; behind him a CCTV screen shows the empty floor
expected_visuals.9: The narrator sits at his desk; the phone right in front of him flashes red; coworkers have their backs turned
expected_visuals.10: Extreme close-up of a hand slowly lifting the phone handset
expected_visuals.11: Close-up of the narrator holding the handset, eyes widening; a faint silhouette stands at the far desk behind him
expected_visuals.12: The narrator's empty desk with the handset off the hook; across the floor a new agent at the far desk looks at her ringing phone

visual_review.instructions: Two frames per clip (a = 25%, b = 75%). Confirm each clip shows its expected visual, clips are in story order, no clip repeats, no text/watermark/garbled faces, characters stay consistent.
visual_review.claude: PASS: 12 clips in script order, no repeated shots, narrator look consistent (clips 3, 9, 11), guard consistent (7, 8). Minor: faint background building sign and a 'SECURITY' lanyard print — judged OK. Clip 7 ends on the floor instead of the lobby; clip 11's silhouette is not visible — story still reads.
